title: [UI/UX] support is required to design the Loss Adjuster Rating survey experience within the Provider Management module.

walkthroughSteps.title: Rate this adjuster
walkthroughSteps.body: Once a loss adjuster's assignment is eligible for review, a rating action appears alongside their row.
walkthroughSteps.expectedAfterClick: Opens the loss adjuster rating survey modal.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Eligible provider assignments show a Rate this adjuster action
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
When a provider assignment is eligible for review, **Rate this adjuster** appears next to Send communication on that row.

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** Jira says: "Design the survey form layout, mapping fields from the existing Loss Adjuster Rating (Lead) (FINAL) reference form". The prototype has one star rating and a comment box instead of that form. The screen differs from Jira, pending product sign-off.

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** Jira says: "The survey should not be intrusive but must be visible enough to ensure completion by the claims handler". The prototype decides on a quiet tertiary "Rate this adjuster" button on the row. Not in Jira, pending product sign-off.

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** Jira says: "Target: medium & large losses (claims >100k, preferably all claims)". The prototype drops the >100k target and shows the action on every eligible assignment. Not in Jira, pending product sign-off.

setup.description: Uses CLM-2024-001's existing provider assignments: no override needed

preconditions.text: At least one provider row shows Rate this adjuster

expectedUI.description: Rating survey modal opens for an eligible assignment
visualCues: Rate this adjuster button visible on eligible rows

howToTest.trigger: Click Rate this adjuster on an eligible provider row
howToTest.expectedResult: Loss adjuster rating survey modal opens
